name: Libreville (Gabon)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the full arms of Libreville: a shield beneath a mural crown, supported by two gold sea-lions holding the national tricolour, with the motto 'Libertas ex amicitia nascitur'.
history: The city's white flag bears its full achievement of arms, with sea-lion supporters holding the Gabonese tricolour; a variant adds the city's name beneath. It was reported in 2016 and no adoption date has been published.

features.role: arms of Libreville with mural crown and sea-lion supporters
